title: Trigger.dev Waitpoint Token
description: A waitpoint token used for human-in-the-loop and external-completion workflows. A run pauses until the token is completed via API, callback URL, or the useWaitToken React hook.

id.description: Unique waitpoint token identifier (prefixed with waitpoint_)

status.description: Current state of the waitpoint token

url.description: Callback URL for completing this waitpoint via HTTP POST

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key used at creation to prevent duplicate tokens

data.description: Completion payload returned to the waiting run when the token is completed
